{{Quote|Well, it appears the superlaser works.|Admiral Motti, upon the destruction of the ''[[Fortressa]]''|<ref name="Death Star" />}}
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] launched an '''attack''' to preemptively destroy or significantly damage the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] while it was nearing completion in orbit above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Despayre]].

It was an unconditional disaster for the Rebels. The group lost at least 500 of their premier [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] assets as well as a large [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] [[Capital ship/Legends|capital starship]]. For the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]], it represented the first operational testing of the [[Death/Legends|Death]] Star's [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] and gave the crew confidence in the capability of the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].

==Background==
The battle was preceded by a series of acts of sabotage during the construction of the Death Star that culminated in the destruction of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Undauntable]]''. This caused [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Tarkin]] to suspect the presence of a cell of Rebel agents or sympathizers working within the project, and privately he had anticipated some form of military incursion.

==The battle==
The modified Rebel [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class]] starfighter carrier ''[[Fortressa]]'' unexpectedly slipped out of hyperspace within close proximity to the Death Star in a surprise attack. Reverting to [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] 2,200 kilometers out from the battle station in Sector Seven of its defense grid, the Rebel ship managed to bypass the [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Fleet]], commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Motti]], stationed in-system and charged with the Death Star's protection.

The ''Fortressa'' immediately commenced the launch of two waves of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wings]] of 250 starfighters each. On training maneuvers close to the surface of the Death Star, 1,120 [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] from several squadrons, including [[Alpha Squadron]], moved quickly to respond. They were led by Flight Commander [[Drolan]] and included notable pilots such as Lieutenant Commander [[Villian Dance]].

===The Death Star is fired===
{{Quote|All right boys, let's pull the hammer back and cock this sodder!|[[Master chief petty officer]] [[Tenn Graneet]]|<ref name="Death Star" />}}
The Imperial fighters held to a perimeter 1,000 km from the station while the Rebel fighters closed to range. From within the command center, Moff Tarkin ordered the Death Star's superlaser station to target the ''Fortressa''. From within 28 seconds of receiving the warning to confirmatory order, the Rebel starship was completely atomized at a range of 2,209 km using only four percent of the station's destructive power.

The Imperial starfighters then engaged the first wave of disoriented Rebel fighters, who were continuing on mission towards the Death Star. The Rebel fighters were flying non-evasively towards the main objective and were largely annihilated with relativity minor losses incurred by Imperial forces. The second wave of 250 Rebel fighters were destroyed by TIE squadrons launched from the Star Destroyers, with none making it to the Death Star's fighter screen.

During the course of the engagement, Admiral [[Natasi Daala|Daala]], who had been inbound to the Death Star when the ''Fortressa'' arrived, was critically injured when her ship was attacked by a squadron of X-wings causing damage to the bridge.
